use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

claims.content: C2 JU defines reference points and geometric areas — specifically EW AOPs — using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum.

scope_contract.goal_statement: C2 JU defines reference points and geometric areas (EW AOPs) using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU defines one EW AOP (a reference point/geometric area) by supplying the required J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum, and that definition is successfully represented.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU begins defining a reference point or geometric area (canonically an EW AOP) to be represented.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The EW AOP/reference point has been defined using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum.
in_scope_actions: Define an EW AOP as a reference point/geometric area
Express the definition using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence (as a minimum)
excluded_adjacent_actions: Requesting or reporting filters for Reference Points via the J7.6 message
Using or disseminating the defined AOP/reference point after definition
Administrative management of reference point definitions
variant_dimensions: Type of reference point/geometric area being defined (EW AOP as the canonical instance)
Optional word-sequence content beyond the minimum J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 sequence

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU is capable of generating and maintaining track numbers.
The C2 JU has at least one available AOP input source: organic data, exchanged lines of bearing (LOBs), EW fix data, or a combination of these.
The C2 JU is the originating unit for the J3.7 EW Fix/AOP/LOB report and therefore retains reporting responsibility.
The C2 JU initiates the definition of a reference point by generating the J3.0I Reference Point initial word.
The C2 JU reports the EW AOP using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum.
The C2 JU sets the FIX BRG field in the J3.7I word to value 1 to indicate an AOP report.
The C2 JU includes the time the AOP was valid in the J3.7I word.
The C2 JU defines the AOP geometry in the J3.7C2 word.

Diverges from Step 1: When the EW AOP results from previously reported LOBs, the C2 JU assigns the EW AOP a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs, before reporting it using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence.

Diverges from Step 1: When the EW AOP results from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs, the C2 JU assigns the EW AOP a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes, before reporting it using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence.
Diverges from Step 1: When a fix is changed to an AOP, the C2 JU uses the TN of the previously reported fix for the new AOP rather than assigning a new TN.
Exception branch from Step 1: If the EW AOP is formed from a single fix, the C2 JU retains the same TN. Exit: continue with Step 1 using the retained TN.
Exception branch from Step 1: If the EW AOP is formed from 2 or more fixes, the C2 JU assigns a new TN. Exit: continue with Step 1 using the newly assigned TN.
Exception branch from Step 1: For data report type 4 (datum), the C2 JU may use the same TN by operator action. Exit: continue with Step 1 using the operator-selected TN.
The EW AOP is defined and represented in the system using the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum, with all required fields (FIX BRG = 1, validity time, and geometry) correctly populated.
If the EW AOP definition is formed from a single fix, the system retains the original Track Number (TN) for the AOP.
If the EW AOP definition is formed from multiple fixes, the system reflects the new entity type by assigning a new TN to the AOP and dropping the original TN.
If the EW AOP results from previously reported LOBs, it has been assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.

If the EW AOP is slaved to a Related TN (Slaved Indicator = 1), the AOP position is established as Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude from the Related TN at report time, maintaining constant true or relative bearing and range.
